style: Stylised high-fantasy MMORPG creature, semi-realistic hand-painted game asset in the spirit of Lineage 2, bold readable shapes, clean silhouette, crisp painted colours, no baked shadows or reflections.
frame: One creature alone, the whole body visible from the top of the head to the ground and the tip of the tail, centred, standing still in its rest pose, mouth closed, limbs clearly apart from the body and from each other, even flat studio lighting, plain neutral grey background, no ground, no shadow, no base, no rider, no saddle, no text, no watermark.

war_wolf.prompt: A huge armoured war wolf seen in a three-quarter view from the front left, standing square on four straight legs with the paws flat on the ground, the head level and pointing forward, the ears up, the bushy tail held straight out behind and slightly down. Thick blue-grey fur, plates of blued steel along the spine and over the shoulders, a steel plate over the forehead and the top of the muzzle, glowing blue runes engraved on the plates, pale glowing blue eyes.

mirage.prompt: A slender unicorn made of water and mist seen in a three-quarter view from the front left, standing square on four straight vertical legs, the neck raised and the head held high, the tail hanging straight down. A pale water-blue pearly coat with faint wave patterns, a flowing aquamarine mane lying flat on the neck, a long pale-blue crystal spiral horn pointing forward and up from the forehead, silver hooves.

seraphim.prompt: A noble winged unicorn seen in a three-quarter view from the front left, standing square on four straight vertical legs, the neck raised and the head held high. A short full golden tail hanging straight down close behind the rump and ending well above the hocks, never reaching the ground. A pure white coat, a golden mane and hooves, a long golden spiral horn pointing forward and up from the forehead, white feathered wings edged in gold folded down flat and tight against its sides like a resting swan's, lying along the back from the shoulders to the hips, not raised, their tips above the hind legs and clear of them, nothing hanging between the legs.

soulless.prompt: A floating hooded wraith seen straight from the front, symmetric, in a T-pose with both arms held straight out to the sides and flat. A deep ragged hood with only darkness inside and two glowing toxic-green eyes, gaunt bony clawed hands with the fingers spread, torn sleeves hanging from the arms, a long tattered dark robe hanging straight down and ending in ragged strips, no legs and no feet, a sickly green glow along the torn hems.

spectral_lord.prompt: A giant spectral knight seen straight from the front, in a T-pose with the arms held out to the sides and slightly lowered, the legs straight and slightly apart. Black and violet plate armour, spiked pauldrons, a closed horned great helm with glowing violet eye slits, violet ghost fire flickering at the shoulders, elbows and knees, a huge black greatsword gripped in the right fist with the blade pointing straight down beside the leg.
